role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
description: The manifesto target of 50,000 additional nurses in the English NHS by 2024 was achieved by September 2023 on the government's full-time-equivalent measure. Nuffield noted unusually strong growth and dependence on overseas recruitment.
evidence: Nuffield Trust states the 50,000-nurse manifesto pledge was achieved.

review.note: Dataset reverses the conclusion of its named source. Nuffield says 50,000 increase achieved by September 2023. Measure is full-time-equivalent English NHS nurses including general practice, excluding health visitors; it is not all UK NHS.
